notes.title: Thanks for playing
notes.notes:
hi everybody.
 
 I'm Artur Rezende, Developer of War Cube.
 First of all, I would like to thank everyone who bought my game, and also, ask for your help to release a new game on steam.
 The War Cube was my first game, and i'm working hard to bring another game better then the first, so, i'm working on SPACE HIT, and i would be very grateful if you could give me a vote.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=799724492
